text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—During PE class.
Kawakami Princess was chasing after the basketball.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Pass it here, pass it here!
Just give me the ball and I'll shooooot!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, Kawakami-san! Alright...
This time for sure... you can make it happen!

text_block_list.name: Referee
text_block_list.text:
Tweet! Kawakami-san, traveling!
You took more than three steps, so it's the other team's ball.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Gyawaah!? I went and did it again!
Everyone, forgive me pleaseeee!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Kawakami Princess continued her reckless, headlong charges after that and ended up receiving a warning from the referee...
